title: SpectraFit-Core: a Rust-cored nonlinear curve-fitting library with a self-auditing cross-backend benchmark
description: High-performance numerical curve-fitting framework combining a Rust kernel with Pydantic-typed schemas, shipped with a self-auditing cross-backend benchmark that checks its own speed and accuracy claims against independent oracles (lmfit, SciPy, JAX/optimistix) and NIST StRD certified reference values. Beta software: APIs and the benchmark contract may still change before a stable 1.0 release.
